summary: Ambow Education Holding Ltd. filed a Form 8-K on May 28, 2026, announcing the launch of the HybriU Partner Portal, an AI-native platform for sales partner management. The press release details a new channel partner program with 150-plus applicants and an uncapped commission structure for distributing HybriU phygital products globally. No financial terms, board recommendation, or events altering corporate structure were disclosed. This is a routine product launch and channel expansion, not a special situation like M&A, restructuring, or capital returns. The filing does not trigger a special-situations classification; it is a standard business update.
